label: pinnedSha256 is read only by planFileOverlay and classifyDestination; planDirectoryOverlay, planSkillRootOverlay and planRemoveRootOverlay never receive acceptedSha256 and never read the field, so a pin declared on a multi-output row is silently inert with no load-time warning

captureUnderLock resolves the path against analysis.records and refuses with 'path is not an overlay destination' when no plan record exists, so a file added only in the live tree cannot be captured into a directory or skill-root overlay even though captureRecordForPath already returned a record for it

capture on a json-entry prints the 'edit the overlay source instead' refusal before the in-sync check, so a no-op capture reports a refusal rather than 'nothing to capture', and the message does not name the JSON key the row owns

apply does repair layout links: analyze appends layout records, runCheck reports them as layout problems, and applyUnderLock calls applyLayoutLink before regeneration with a re-check of the replaced link; however applyUnderLock returns EXIT_CONFLICT before the repair loop, so a missing link stays missing while any unrelated entry is in conflict and the conflict report does not say so

pinnedSha256 appears in no operator-facing markdown; a repo-wide *.md search returns only the research packet, so the only drift guard for a file overlay is undocumented for external-repo maintainers authoring .skilled-overlays.json

a skill-root file outside the replace prefixes and not retained falls through to the generic 'path is not an overlay destination' refusal, which misstates ownership: the path is inside an overlay destination but is upstream-owned
